title: Introduce anchored repair orchestrator and span-aware gating CI hook
author: Maya Chen
body:
Motivation: We keep seeing transient prompt-set regressions that are localized to small input spans or to particular provenance buckets (derived from data ingestion/annotation pipelines). Existing CI gates flag failures but provide little automated remediation guidance, which slows on-call and release engineering. This PR introduces two coordinated capabilities: 1) a Span-Aware Gate CI hook that computes span-level divergence scores (token-range / semantic span) and escalates failures only when divergence is broad or repeated across anchors; 2) an Anchored Repair Orchestrator that runs staged repair actions (replay with alternative prompts, selective re-ranking, contextual anchoring) against failing prompt sets and produces an ordered repair plan for human review or automated patching.

What this changes (high level): adds a CI hook that (a) attaches span metadata to eval traces, (b) computes per-span divergence and hit-counts across anchors; integrates with the existing smoke / regression pipeline to produce a contextual fail reason tag (SPAN_WIDE, SPAN_NARROW, PROVENANCE_SKINNY). Adds an orchestrator service within eval-harness that: - selects anchor examples (stable sentinel prompts) and fuzzed variants; - runs staged repairs (replay with prefix-anchoring, candidate prompting, lightweight reranker, and conservative output masking); - records repair summaries and suggested patch artifacts (prompt diffs, config deltas); - emits a suggested rollback or canary plan when repairs fail or introduce new regressions. The orchestrator is opt-in per-promptset via a new yml config (eval_harness/configs/promptset_repair.yml).

Implementation notes: - Python 3.11-compatible module eval_harness/orchestrator/anchored_repair.py (actor + runner + simple state machine) - CI hook implemented as ci/hooks/span_gate.yaml and ci/hooks/span_gate_runner.py (invoked by the existing eval-ci entrypoint) - Telemetry tags added to all eval traces: span_id, anchor_id, provenance_bucket - New compact export format for repair proposals: /exports/repair_proposals/<pr-number>.ndjson - Unit + integration tests in tests/test_anchored_repair.py and smoke tests under tests/ci_span_gate_smoke.py - Docs: docs/anchored_repair.md and examples/repair_playbook.md

Checklist: [x] design doc linked in Linear ENG-4829 [x] unit tests [x] integration smoke tests [x] telemetry + tags emitted [x] docs updated [x] e2e run in staging (passed) [x] performance benching for hook latency included

Risk and mitigation: The span computations add a second pass over tokens; we implemented early-exit heuristics and thresholded sampling to keep median CI hook latency within 1.2x baseline. The orchestrator runs in a sandboxed job with bounded retries to avoid accidental mass replays. Config opt-in prevents accidental activation for all prompt sets.
commits: f2a3b1c: add anchored_repair orchestrator module + state machine
9d8e44b: introduce span-gate CI hook and runner; wire into eval-ci pipeline
3c1b7e2: add telemetry tags (span_id, anchor_id, provenance_bucket) to trace exporter
a7f4d90: add unit tests and CI smoke tests for span gate and orchestrator
b6e2c11: docs: add anchored_repair.md and repair_playbook examples
d4a2e55: add export writer for repair proposals and backfill script
c8f0a01: fix: reduce span analysis cost by sampling and early-exit heuristics
review_conversation: Arjun Patel (reviewer): The span scoring looks sensible but the metric names collide with existing 'divergence_score' in the registry. Please namespace them (span_divergence / anchor_hit_count) and add a short migration note.
Maya Chen (author): Updated metric names and added a compatibility shim in telemetry/exporter to populate old names for dashboards. Added migration note to docs.
Benji Park (reviewer): Tests look good. Concern: orchestrator might produce many suggested patches for large promptsets. Can we cap proposals per-run and add a priority heuristic?
Maya Chen (author): Added cap (default 5 proposals/run) and a priority heuristic (anchor_hit_count * span_width) used to rank proposals. Documented the tunable in config file.
Sofia Alvarez (reviewer): Can we avoid flakiness on CI by making the smoke-test seeds deterministic and lowering non-deterministic timeouts?
Maya Chen (author): Set deterministic seeds in smoke tests and added a retry for an occasional network flake in the backfill script. Reran pipeline and all green.
Sofia Alvarez (reviewer): Approving after the fixes; verified the CI run in staging and the metrics emitted properly.
merge_outcome: Merged to main via squash (squash commit f1d2e3). PR automatically closed after squash merge. Generated release note stanza and exported repair proposal artifacts to /exports/repair_proposals/835117.ndjson.
release_notes:
- Add Span-Aware Gate CI hook that computes span-level divergence and reduces noisy false positives.
- Introduce Anchored Repair Orchestrator that stages automated repair attempts and outputs patch proposals for failing prompt sets.
- Telemetry: new tags span_id, anchor_id, provenance_bucket for easier triage.
- Opt-in config promptset_repair.yml to control rollout and proposal caps.
notes_for_oncall: Span gate may increase CI runtime slightly; configured default sampling and an early-exit threshold to bound latency. If staging shows elevated failure noise for a promptset, disable the orchestrator for that promptset via eval_harness/configs/promptset_repair.yml -> enabled: false and re-run the CI. Repair proposals are idempotent ndjson lines and can be replayed against staging without affecting production.
